concept:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: complete primary screen concept for a self-hosted 2D preschool browser game called Little Sprouts.
Audience: three-year-old children with parent assistance. Desktop/laptop first; landscape touch mobile later. Functional game hub, not a marketing site. User content: Numbers 1–10, all alphabet A–Z, Colors, Shapes, Our world (familiar objects); choose a character and theme; small parent settings entry.
Design a polished complete 1440x900 app screenshot. Warm storybook forest illustration, calm cream #FCF9F1 canvas, deep forest #244D3C text, moss green #55845B, muted apricot and butter yellow accents. Round substantial readable sans typography (Nunito-like), generous whitespace, tactile cream controls and subtle shadows. Header about 100px: small native leaf mark plus "little sprouts" on left, profile "Little Explorer" with circular fox avatar, speaker icon, simple "Grown-ups" button on right.
Below header show a large open illustrated welcome region 330px high: left heading exactly "Little adventures.\nBig discoveries.", small supporting line "Pick a game and let's explore.", two theme choices "Woodland" and "Starlight". Right: exquisite 2D storybook little orange fox and cream rabbit smiling in a sunny soft meadow with flowers and rounded trees. Illustration has no enclosing card and blends seamlessly into cream canvas. Two small character portrait choices nearby, labeled "Milo" and "Pip", Milo selected.
Below at y560 show heading "What shall we play?" and one deliberate horizontal row of five large rounded activity selection tiles: "Numbers" with big "1 2 3" and small "Count to 10"; "Letters" with big "Aa" and small "Explore A–Z"; "Colors" with three colored circles and small "A world of color"; "Shapes" with simple circle/triangle/square and small "Find a match"; "Our world" with apple/ball illustration and small "Name & discover". Individual accent colors muted green, apricot, lilac, blue, yellow. These are big child-accessible actual game buttons, not generic marketing cards. Footer tiny "A little discovery, every day." No fake metrics, rewards counters, badges, eyebrow text, sidebars, dense dashboards, advertisements or unrelated navigation.
Native HTML text/buttons, reusable components. Artwork separable in dedicated asset pass. Must include the entire screen, every listed control and tile, complete margins and footer. Make it charming, clean, and beautifully readable rather than busy.

assets.characters: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent mascot sprite atlas for the Little Sprouts 2D preschool browser game. The reference image is STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY. Create a brand-new transparent PNG atlas, exactly 2 columns and 2 rows, equal size cells, generous transparent padding around every sprite, no borders, no text. Four separated full-body sprites with consistent size and registration: top-left Milo the little orange fox standing happily facing slightly right with open eyes; top-right Pip the cream white rabbit standing happily facing slightly left with open eyes; bottom-left the SAME fox celebrating with eyes closed and arms raised; bottom-right the SAME rabbit celebrating with eyes closed and arms raised. Preserve the beautiful watercolor children's storybook rendering, fluffy orange fur, cream cheeks, friendly expressions, rounded proportions of the concept. The fox and rabbit must each fit fully into its cell, ears and tails included; no overlap between cells, no props behind characters, no scenery, no floor or shadows outside small grounded shadow. Real transparent background. Production quality charming art, consistent face identity across poses.
assets.backgrounds: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production background atlas for Little Sprouts game. Reference is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate one WIDE landscape atlas containing EXACTLY two equal-height full-width horizontal scenes, one above the other, with a clean straight division at the exact halfway point; no border and no labels. Each scene is a very wide 3:1 panoramic watercolor storybook background. TOP HALF: sunny woodland meadow matching the reference, rounded green trees, delicate yellow flowers and daisies, tree trunk at far right, distant blue-green hills, inviting lush grass lower edge. BOTTOM HALF: same landscape at magical twilight, muted lavender blue sky, soft glowing crescent moon and stars at upper right, gentle lavender hills and rounded trees, same grounding meadow, magical and comforting. Both scenes: keep leftmost 40% almost entirely flat warm cream #FCF9F1 and fade gently from cream into the illustrated meadow toward the right so native interface text can overlay left. Scene illustration mainly right 60%. No characters; mascots layered separately. No words, letters, numbers, controls, icons, borders or watermark. Storybook watercolor paper texture consistent with concept, beautifully detailed but calm. Overall preferred image aspect ratio 3:2 (two 3:1 scenes stacked).
assets.objects: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: production transparent educational object atlas for Little Sprouts preschool game. Reference is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a regular grid of EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 clearly separated individual pictures, with equal cell size and generous transparent gutters. Exact order, reading left to right: ROW ONE red apple with green leaf; yellow banana; colorful red blue white beach ball; brown teddy bear toy. ROW TWO friendly orange cat; friendly brown dog; little blue bird; orange fish. ROW THREE small blue toy car; simple blue drinking cup with handle; red child's shoe; small leafy green tree. Each is one recognizable complete object, consistent scale and registration, entirely inside its own cell. Soft watercolor children's storybook illustration matching concept, simple accurate silhouettes recognizable by age three, slightly textured paint, no faces on inanimate objects, no extra props, no text, no labels, no digits, no border. True transparent background, not a checkerboard drawing. The atlas will be sliced into 12 independent illustrations by the game, so keep exact regular cell placement. Preferred square-ish 4:3 image composition.
